Repeatable automated browser tests prove the main nostalgic workflow, local persistence, backup and AI failure fallback, with a traceable evidence checklist.

## Context

- [ ] Test posting, reply references, unread tracking, reload persistence and JSON export/import round-trip using an isolated browser profile.
- [ ] Test offline/unsupported-WebGPU behavior and mocked AI generation including interrupted-run duplicate prevention without downloading a real model.
- [ ] Assert no app backend/API key is needed for normal manual use, and no unverified historical prompts are labeled as authenticated reproductions.
- [ ] Document which visual/era details remain provisional, test commands actually executed, and any skipped hardware-dependent checks.

## Optional validation
Human nostalgic-fidelity review by a former PC-VAN user, explicitly optional because subjective approval is not required for pre-merge completion.
